title: LiveChat Review (2026)
intro: LiveChat is evaluated here as a live chat and website messenger support platform — LiveChat is Text's (formerly LiveChat Inc.) website live chat platform for sales and support teams with routing, canned responses, and chat analytics. Annual per-person pricing: Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per person/month billed annually. Part of the Text ecosystem (ChatBot, HelpDesk, KnowledgeBase). Scored as live-chat-support primary. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's customer-service methodology (ease of use, support job fit, workflow depth, omnichannel, self-service, integrations, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose LiveChat when proven website live chat with Text suite expansion paths matters — and you accept per-agent pricing without a free tier.
verdict: Choose LiveChat when proven website live chat with Text suite expansion paths matters — and you accept per-agent pricing without a free tier. Compare Freshchat for a free 10-agent tier and Tidio for conversation-cap SMB pricing with bundled Lyro AI. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
